description: Paste or forward a suspicious message. Hunch reads only the words you give it, on one frozen engine (the same engine behind the Hunch extension and site, running on our server), and tells you in plain language what stands out and the smallest next step you can take. It never tells you a message is trustworthy and never calls anyone a scammer. Your text is analyzed, not stored.

sender.description: Optional: who it is from (email address or domain). If absent, Hunch says it cannot verify the sender.

subject.description: Optional: the subject line, for emails.

text.description: The message text to check (required). Paste the words, not a screenshot.

name: check_message
title: Check a message
